description: Transactional outbox and inbox for .NET: the event written with your data reaches the broker, and the consumer's database effect is applied once. Core contracts; depends only on Microsoft.Extensions.*.
Test doubles for Waybill: an in-memory outbox and inbox with assertions, so application code that enqueues or consumes messages can be tested without PostgreSQL. Reference it from test projects only.
RabbitMQ transport for Waybill: publisher confirms, persistent messages and mandatory routing.
EF Core and PostgreSQL persistence for Waybill: outbox capture in the same transaction, migrations, and the dispatcher claim.
